title: 🎉 Sam Marine wins the Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust Prize
summary: Sam Marine, 3rd year dissertation student, has won the Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust Prize for the highest project mark.
content: Congratulations to Sam Marine, 3rd year dissertation student, who has won the Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust Prize for the highest project mark in their cohort.
A brilliant way to cap off a dissertation project, and a testament to the level of rigour students in the lab bring to their work.
